integrity: Analytical proof with separate finite-state numerical sanity checks; no numerical test substitutes for the Lévy exit theorem.
scientific_limitations: Strictly stable symmetric alpha in (0,2), finite fixed irreducible reset-site chain, fixed positive reset rate, sites at macroscopic interior fractions; asymptotics only, independent audit not performed.
title: Markov-correlated reset sites have a stationary-averaged Lévy escape law
